what: Each line of the large pledge title has an accent-color band behind the letters. When a line reaches 90% of the screen, the band fills from the left 0 → 101% width over 1.5s power3.out while the line turns on from transparent 0 → 1 — white letters remain as if printed on a blue band. Each line is triggered separately, so they are painted in order from the top line

options.ease: Curve, default power3.out — the Hero Korean strip uses power2.inOut 1s

note: Bar color is --fx-bar-color (default --kf-accent). The line is width: fit-content, so it fills only as wide as the text. The original grows the CSS variable --width with GSAP
